backupPolicy: Encrypted local archive of the actual private stack and final quiesced user state; public Git contains configuration and checksums only.
cutoverPolicy: Prepare target privately. Require healthy model, readable history and preserved workspace hashes. Stop old Tailscale identity before starting its migrated copy. Update fixed Cloudflare instance ID only after target readiness.
sourceRetirement: Stop source after successful cutover; retain its disk as explicit rollback pending later retirement.
backgroundPreviewPolicy: Preserve project files and state. Do not blindly restore detached tool preview servers that were preventing automatic sleep.
secrets: Preserve credentials, browser authentication, Tailscale state and Web Push registrations only in encrypted transfer/private root-owned storage, never Git.
